D50·ebpx — 2026-11-14
chose: On a minted-suffix collision, re-run the conformance case with fresh ids (harness suffixCollision, up to 3 runs)
over: Masking only suffixes adjacent to a minted id, or loosening the golden comparison
because: A rendered handle carries no trace of which id made it, so no mask can tell a minted suffix from an equal existing one. A re-run keeps every byte compared, and the odds of three collisions in a row are negligible.
